rationale: Identity was correctly verified via email. The agent obtained explicit confirmation before each order-changing action and successfully: (1) updated the shipping address on order #W1603792 to the new address found in the luggage order, and (2) changed the user’s default address to the same. However, the agent failed the user’s tablet request: it claimed the cheapest available tablet was the 7-inch/128GB/black at $941.03, but the product list shows a cheaper available option (10-inch/64GB/silver at $903.95). The final modification switched to a non-cheapest option, so the agent did not perform the requested change correctly. Additionally, the agent briefly misstated that the order was delivered before correcting and asserted a policy about no further changes being allowed without tool support. These issues mean the outcome does not meet the pass bar for correctness and policy adherence.
